script_text: Everything you buried for months is about to surface, Taurus, and it changes what you choose this week. Early week, Monday through Wednesday, Venus forms a trine to your 5th House. Mid-week, Thursday brings the turning point as Mars enters your 10th House, igniting career ambition and a money opportunity you cannot ignore. Late week, the Moon in your 1st House conjunct Jupiter lifts your confidence. The weekend favors a committed partnership conversation under a favorable Venus-Jupiter sextile. Friday is your power day because Venus activates your 2nd House of wealth and pleasure. Tuesday is your worst day because Mercury's square clouds a contract and a romantic promise. As an earth sign ruled by Venus, ground one decision in your values before you move. Follow for daily updates.
